page.overview:
Who is Mister Liu?

Mister Liu is a recurring minor antagonist in Invincible, debuting in the first season and appearing throughout the series. He was the ruthless former leader of the international criminal organization known as the Order. Possessing the ability to project his soul in the form of a powerful Eastern dragon, he has proven to be a formidable opponent to crime lords such as Titan and Machine Head, as well as heroes such as Invincible.

During his confrontation with Invincible and Titan, Liu was seemingly killed by Machine Head, one of his own subordinates who sought to take control of the Order. Machine Head worked with Titan to orchestrate his downfall and subsequently seized leadership of the Order from him. Liu's bodyguard, Great Wall, later recovered his body and resurrected him, although the process left Liu severely weakened.

Following his revival, Liu had lost control of the Order and sought revenge against Titan for his role in this. He threatened Titan's family by hiring Magnattack to assassinate them. After Magnattack failed, Titan enlisted the aid of Oliver and confronted Lie while he was still weakened. Although he initially overpowered them, Invincible arrived and helped Oliver overwhelm Liu, forcing him to retreat alongside his bodyguard.

Ultimately, both Liu and Titan returned to the Order, only to discover that Machine Head, who wished to have them both return to the Order under his control, had manipulated the events surrounding their conflict.
